thread:
Priya: Quick feedback round on the 'billing summary card' mock. Considering swapping the spend breakdown (pie) with a stacked bar to make trend comparisons easier. Thoughts on readability and mobile? Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/def (Billing cards page).

Owen: Stacked bar wins for trends, pie is noisy for many segments. On mobile a stacked bar can compress badly; we should switch to an interactive mini-chart that toggles between stacked/segmented list depending on width.

Dee: Accessibility: arcs in pie are hard to hit for tooltips. Bars are better for focusable regions. Also label colors need to be consistent with legend colorblind palette.

Priya: Good call. Also thinking about token vs cost toggle in that card. Users sometimes want quick USD numbers. Maybe a small toggle on the card header.

Owen: If we show both token and USD we should include unit labels: "3.4M tokens (~$12.34)". Keep two decimals for currency but whole numbers for tokens.

metrics-bot: Telemetry: card impressions and toggle flips will be recorded under event `billing.card_view` and `billing.toggle_units`.

Priya: Final: moving to stacked bar with unit toggle and mobile fallback to list. I'll update frames and add a11y notes in the figma file.

Dee: I'll run a quick contrast pass and add keyboard nav notes for the mini-chart.

Priya: Thanks!
